versions.changelog: Restore ClawHub display name 'X (Twitter) Hot Topics' (publish metadata fix). Content identical to 2.0.0: browser-first rewrite — logged-in x.com Top search / Explore trending as primary source; X API free-tier search demoted to optional fallback (X_BEARER_TOKEN optional).

x-hots 2.0.0 introduces a new browser-based primary data source for trending X topics, greatly improving accuracy over the API-only method.

- Fetches trending topics, Explore trends, and top tweets via a logged-in x.com browser (no credentials needed); API is fallback only.
- Details robust browser session management, X login state checks, and Cloudflare challenge handling.
- Clearly distinguishes full-index browser results from API fallback (which misses many viral tweets), warning not to use API-only data as definitive.
- Revises workflow and error handling: retries browser nav, never claims "hot" from incomplete data, covers fallback API limitations.
- Removes now-redundant environment/config/entrypoint file details; focuses on effective data extraction, ranking, domain parsing, and reporting.

Add an isolated per-skill virtualenv entrypoint (scripts/x_hots): provisions .venv on first run and auto-installs tweepy (now declared in requirements.txt). SKILL.md updated to invoke scripts/x_hots; no manual pip install needed.

- Adds automated virtual environment setup and dependency installation via the scripts/x_hots entrypoint; manual pip installation is no longer required.
- Updates documentation for the new one-step usage: simply run scripts/x_hots with JSON query input.
- Now uses requirements.txt for dependency pinning.
- Old documentation, licenses, and markdown guides (README, LICENSE, CHANGELOG, etc.) have been removed.
- Introduces _meta.json for skill metadata.
Add CHANGELOG.md tracking notable changes per release; attach release notes to the ClawHub publication.

- Documentation updated from version 1.1.1 to 1.4.0 in SKILL.md.
- No functional or code changes described; this release is documentation-only.
- All core usage instructions, workflow, API details, and error handling remain the same.

- Added documentation files: CLAUDE.md, LICENSE, README.md, and README.zh-CN.md
- Removed skill-card.md to streamline documentation
- No changes to SKILL.md functionality or description
- Expanded documentation and licensing information for broader user support

x-hots 1.3.0 changelog

- Switched authentication method to use only X (Twitter) Bearer Token (OAuth 2.0) for broader and simpler API access
- Updated documentation to remove need for API key, API secret, access token, and access token secret environment variables
- Improved error messages and instructions for missing authentication
- Removed "skill-card.md" from the repository
Change name from x-hots to 'X Hot Topics'
Add prerequisites: Python dependencies and X API environment variables

**Summarizes trending topics and public opinion from X/Twitter by user interest domain.**

- Added workflow to extract user interest domains or topics from natural language inputs.
- Fetches top trending tweets per domain or topic using a Python script and presents up to 10 items per query.
- Analyzes and summarizes the background, mainstream opinions, and controversies for each hot topic.
- Provides generic trending topic handling when no specific domain is detected.
- Details error handling for API issues and empty results.
- Includes example queries and formatting for clear presentation.
